name: Skill Manager
description: 技能注册权威——四源并集 skills/*/SKILL.md 扫描解析单源（仓根/出厂模式包/用户模式包/用户根，source 标注实际胜出源，与快照侧同源优先序；元数据 name/description/languages + 单技能详情含正文），resource_search skill 面的服务提供方

services.name: skill.list
services.description: List registered skills (metadata: id/name/description/languages/source; sorted by id; source = winning origin repo_root / mode:<plugin_id> / user_root; unreadable entries skipped)

services.name: skill.get
services.description: Get one skill detail (metadata + SKILL.md body content); unknown/malformed id → found=false
